How to use · 使用方法

1 · Policyowner 保单持有人

Tap Policyowner PDF at the top and choose the ePartner Online Enquiry printout (or e-Policy / GE form). Name, NRIC, policy no., Muslim, address fill in by themselves (green boxes). Type anything missing: tel, marital status, children.
点顶部「Policyowner PDF」上传 ePartner Online Enquiry，资料会自动填入（绿色格子）。缺的资料（电话、婚姻状况、孩子人数）自己补上。

Signing date defaults to today. Witness is TAN TECK KANG / 6180237 - tap Change for another agent (this customer only).
签名日期默认今天；见证人默认 TAN TECK KANG，点 Change 可换其他 agent（只限这位客户）。

2 · Nominees 受益人

Tap Screenshot / photo (the customer's WhatsApp reply) or Copied message, or paste the message. Nominees appear as boxes below - fix anything there. Red tags on the right (e.g. Relationship?) jump to the box to fix.
上传客户 WhatsApp 截图或消息，受益人会出现在下方格子里，可直接修改。右边红色标签点一下就跳到要改的地方。

Trustee changes: choose Trustee (form Part 2) - appoint, add, revoke & appoint, or revoke.
更换信托人：在「Trustee (form Part 2)」选择委任、追加、撤销后委任或撤销。

3 · Forms to print 打印表格

Tick the forms you need - the nominee form and any GE form (Great ID, PSF01, PSF33, EASI-PAY, NFTF, questionnaires, O&G, clinical abstract). Fill the extra boxes shown under a ticked form. Then tap the one Preview button, check every page, and download - all ticked forms come out as one PDF.
勾选需要的表格（提名表格和其他 GE 表格），填写额外资料，按一个 Preview 按钮预览，确认后下载成一份 PDF。

Left for hand-writing: signatures, card numbers, health answers, the doctor's report.
签名、信用卡号、健康问卷答案、医生报告留给本人亲手填写。

Customers 客户列表

Every customer is saved on this device. Customers reopens one; New customer starts fresh. Use Export backup in the Customers list to keep a copy, and Import backup on a new phone or PC.
客户资料自动保存在这台设备。换手机或电脑前，在 Customers 里按 Export backup 备份，到新设备再 Import backup。

Privacy 隐私

Everything stays on this device - nothing is uploaded. Reading a photo needs internet the first time (to load the reader); the photo itself never leaves the device.
所有资料只留在这台设备，不会上传。

Check the version under the title; if the page looks old, refresh (Ctrl+F5, or pull down on a phone).
